ordering.rule: priority first, then created_at, then id
ordering.not_recency: recency is what put a reviewed-and-merge-ready bead at the top of a dispatch in the first place

filter_can_pass.note: a filter that emptied the list would satisfy every exclusion assertion and be useless; tests assert ordinary ready work SURVIVES

criterion_4_own_labels_RECORDED_not_gate.note: recorded, never gated: these labels change when the reviewer acts, and a gate that flips on someone else's action is not a gate. See criterion_4_bd_offers_no_inherit_labels for what IS gated.

status_map_provenance.note: bd list is partial in BOTH directions: the default returns only non-closed and --status closed only closed, so the map is their merge. Taking either alone makes absence silently mean 'open'.
